records.name: Case report (simple)
records.text: A report of what happened to one person can raise useful questions. It usually cannot separate the treatment effect from other possible explanations.

records.name: Cell line (simple)
records.text: A population of cells maintained through repeated transfers in laboratory culture. Its origin, identity and growth conditions affect what it can model.

Controlled perturbation experiment (simple)
records.text: Change a defined factor and compare the result with suitable controls. A real change in a laboratory test does not by itself show why it happened or that patients benefit.

records.name: CRISPR functional genomics (ar)
records.text: تعطيل كل جين على حدة في الخلايا السرطانية لمعرفة الجينات التي لا تستطيع العيش من دونها.

records.name: CRISPR functional genomics (de)
records.text: Jedes Gen einzeln in Krebszellen ausschalten, um herauszufinden, ohne welche sie nicht überleben können.

records.name: CRISPR functional genomics (es)
records.text: Eliminar cada gen uno por uno en células cancerosas para descubrir sin cuáles no pueden vivir.

records.name: CRISPR functional genomics (fr)
records.text: Inactiver chaque gène, un par un, dans des cellules cancéreuses pour découvrir ceux dont elles ne peuvent pas se passer.

records.name: CRISPR functional genomics (hi)
records.text: कैंसर कोशिकाओं में हर जीन को एक-एक कर बंद करके पता लगाना कि वे किनके बिना नहीं जी सकतीं।

records.name: CRISPR functional genomics (ja)
records.text: がん細胞の遺伝子を一つずつノックアウトして、がん細胞がどの遺伝子なしでは生きられないかを見つける方法です。

records.name: CRISPR functional genomics (pt)
records.text: Desligar cada gene um a um em células cancerosas para descobrir sem quais elas não conseguem viver.

records.name: CRISPR functional genomics (zh)
records.text: 在癌细胞中逐个敲除每个基因，找出它们离不开的基因。

records.name: CRISPR functional genomics (simple)
records.text: Knocking out every gene one by one in cancer cells to find the ones they cannot live without.

records.name: ctDNA and imaging discordance (simple)
records.text: A blood test measures material in a blood sample, while a scan measures a region of the body. Different results need their timing and limits checked before deciding what they mean.

records.name: Curesponse (ar)
records.text: شركة إسرائيلية يُبقي اختبارها cResponse شدفة من ورم المريض حية، مع أوعيتها وخلاياها المناعية، لاختبار العلاجات التي تستجيب لها.

records.name: Curesponse (de)
records.text: Israelisches Unternehmen, dessen cResponse-Test ein Fragment des Patiententumors mitsamt seinen Gefäßen und Immunzellen am Leben hält, um zu prüfen, auf welche Behandlungen es anspricht.

records.name: Curesponse (es)
records.text: Empresa israelí cuya prueba cResponse mantiene vivo un fragmento del tumor del paciente, con sus vasos y sus células inmunitarias, para probar a qué tratamientos responde.

records.name: Curesponse (fr)
records.text: Société israélienne dont le test cResponse maintient en vie un fragment de la tumeur du patient, avec ses vaisseaux et ses cellules immunitaires, pour tester à quels traitements elle répond.

records.name: Curesponse (hi)
records.text: इज़रायली कंपनी जिसका cResponse परीक्षण रोगी के ट्यूमर के एक टुकड़े को उसकी रक्त वाहिकाओं और प्रतिरक्षा कोशिकाओं के साथ जीवित रखता है, ताकि यह जांचा जा सके कि वह किन उपचारों पर प्रतिक्रिया देता है।

records.name: Curesponse (ja)
records.text: イスラエルの企業で、そのcResponse検査は患者の腫瘍片を血管や免疫細胞とともに生かした状態で保ち、どの治療に反応するかを試験する。

records.name: Curesponse (pt)
records.text: Empresa israelense cujo teste cResponse mantém vivo um fragmento do tumor do paciente, com seus vasos e células imunes, para testar a quais tratamentos ele responde.

records.name: Curesponse (zh)
records.text: 一家以色列公司，其cResponse检测使患者的肿瘤碎片连同其血管和免疫细胞保持存活，以测试它对哪些治疗有反应。

records.name: Curesponse (simple)
records.text: Israeli company that keeps a live piece of tumour alive to test treatments on it.

records.name: Endpoint (simple)
records.text: An endpoint says what the study measures and when. The plan states what result would count as success.

Functional (ex vivo) drug testing (simple)
records.text: Testing medicines on collected living cells or tissue under laboratory conditions. The result describes that sample and experiment; whether using it improves care needs separate evidence.

Ex vivo drug sensitivity screening in blood cancers (EXALT) (simple)
records.text: Testing drug responses in collected blood-cancer cells. A result needs the sample, assay and study context; a clinical study of one selection method does not validate every screen.

records.name: In vitro and in vivo (simple)
records.text: Check whether a result was measured in a laboratory, removed living tissue, a living animal or person, or a computer model. Each setting includes and leaves out different things.

records.name: Minimal / molecular residual disease (MRD) (simple)
records.text: A test for small amounts of disease after treatment. A negative result means the test found no qualifying signal in that sample; it does not prove that no cancer remains.

records.name: Organoid (simple)
records.text: A three-dimensional culture that organises selected features of a tissue. A tumour organoid is one type, and its contents need checking before researchers use it to answer a question.

records.name: Patient-derived organoids (simple)
records.text: Cultures grown from a patient's tumour to study selected tissue features and drug responses. They do not recreate the whole patient, and their intended use needs its own evidence.

records.name: Patient-derived xenografts (ar)
records.text: الطعم الأجنبي المشتق من المريض هو ورم مأخوذ من مريض ويُنمّى في فأر، ويُستخدم لاختبار الأدوية قبل أن تصل إلى البشر.

records.name: Patient-derived xenografts (de)
records.text: Ein patientenabgeleitetes Xenotransplantat ist der Tumor eines Patienten, der in einer Maus gezüchtet wird, um Medikamente zu testen, bevor sie beim Menschen ankommen.

records.name: Patient-derived xenografts (es)
records.text: El tumor de un paciente cultivado en un ratón, usado para probar fármacos antes de que lleguen a las personas.

records.name: Patient-derived xenografts (fr)
records.text: Une xénogreffe dérivée de patient est la tumeur d'un patient cultivée chez une souris, utilisée pour tester des médicaments avant qu'ils n'arrivent chez l'humain.

records.name: Patient-derived xenografts (hi)
records.text: चूहे में उगाया गया मरीज़ का ट्यूमर, जो दवाओं को लोगों तक पहुँचने से पहले परखने में प्रयुक्त होता है।

records.name: Patient-derived xenografts (ja)
records.text: 患者由来異種移植モデルとは、患者の腫瘍をマウスの体内で育てたもので、薬が人に届く前に試験するために使われます。

records.name: Patient-derived xenografts (pt)
records.text: O tumor de um paciente cultivado em um camundongo, usado para testar drogas antes de chegarem às pessoas.

records.name: Patient-derived xenografts (zh)
records.text: 在小鼠体内生长的患者肿瘤，用于在药物进入人体前测试。

records.name: Patient-derived xenografts (simple)
records.text: A patient's tumour grown in a mouse, used to test drugs before they are tried in people.

records.name: Pharmacokinetics (PK), half-life and exposure (simple)
records.text: Pharmacokinetics describes how a medicine moves through the body and how its concentration changes over time. The amount given, exposure and biological effect are different measurements.

records.name: Positive predictive value (PPV) (simple)
records.text: Among people with a positive result, how many really meet the condition being tested? The answer depends on the test and the population.

records.name: Randomised trial (simple)
records.text: Chance assigns people to different treatment groups. This helps make a fair comparison, but does not guarantee identical groups or complete follow-up.

records.name: RECIST (ar)
records.text: RECIST هو دليل القواعد المستخدم لقياس ما إذا كانت الأورام قد كبرت أو تقلصت في صور الفحص.

records.name: RECIST (de)
records.text: RECIST ist das Regelwerk, nach dem auf Bildgebungsaufnahmen gemessen wird, ob Tumoren gewachsen oder geschrumpft sind.

records.name: RECIST (es)
records.text: El reglamento para medir si los tumores han crecido o disminuido en las exploraciones.

records.name: RECIST (fr)
records.text: RECIST est le règlement qui sert à mesurer, sur les examens d'imagerie, si les tumeurs ont grossi ou diminué.

records.name: RECIST (hi)
records.text: स्कैन पर ट्यूमर बढ़े या सिकुड़े यह मापने की नियम-पुस्तिका।

records.name: RECIST (ja)
records.text: RECISTは、画像検査で腫瘍が大きくなったか小さくなったかを測るためのルールブックだ。

records.name: RECIST (pt)
records.text: O livro de regras para medir se os tumores cresceram ou encolheram nos exames.

records.name: RECIST (zh)
records.text: 在影像上衡量肿瘤增大或缩小的规则手册。

records.name: RECIST (simple)
records.text: The rulebook for measuring whether tumours have grown or shrunk on scans.

records.name: Surrogate endpoint validation: which stand-ins have earned trust (simple)
records.text: A surrogate endpoint only deserves trust if trials have shown that moving it also moves the outcome that matters, and the record differs from one endpoint to the next.

records.name: Tumour-on-a-chip (simple)
records.text: A small engineered culture device for studying selected tumour interactions. Its cells, channels and conditions vary by design and must be measured.
